scope_limitations: One observed Join and one valid signature.
Passive retention of two public S_x epochs.
The recovered value is the global sanitizer scalar, not the original signer scalar.
The fresh full message changes only the sanitizable component.
The verifier is a source-equivalent reconstruction, not the compiled author binary.

The quantitative evidence is one precommitted exact primary instance plus eight prospectively sealed independent exact trials; seven recovered after one Join and the residual trial recovered after two further public epochs.
The separate sk_s<min(sk_i) correctness defect is excluded.
repair_direction: Do not publish multiple ordinary-integer masks sharing one sanitizer scalar as a common factor; use epoch-specific scalars and bound key/version semantics or conventional recipient-specific key establishment, then reanalyze correctness and security.
